text:
alice: ok team, I just cut rc/2026-03-21-1 from main. asking for quick thumbs and any hold flags. will pin artifacts once we have +1

ben: thanks. can we confirm the DB migration is behind a feature flag?

alice: yes -- migration is opt-in via env FEATURE_MIGRATE=false by default. migration binary included in the build but won't run unless flag flipped.

carmen: running smoke in staging now. posting logs in a sec.

deploybot: [deploybot] build 2026-03-21-1 created for rc/2026-03-21-1 - artifact: redwood-inference:v2026-03-21-1 - sha: abcdef123456

carmen: smoke: a few 502s at start, but looks stable. latency median 85ms, p95 230ms. no ranking regressions in the quick-eval.

alice: great. @sheriff_miguel do you want to take the sheriff handoff?

sheriff_miguel: taking it. I'll watch canary for 20m. set the promo window to 10:30-10:50 PT?

dave: changelog excerpt for release notes (short):
- improve KV cache warm-up for reprompt flows
- reduce CPU overhead on quantized64 path
- fix race in model-router when node drains

ben: quick question on rollback surface: if the new model variant OOMs, do we fallback to v2026-03-21-0 automatically?

alice: routing policy includes model-variant fallback to previous pinned version in the same family. fallback max retries = 2.

deploybot: [deploybot] canary start: rc/2026-03-21-1 -> staging pool (10%) at 1734567925

carmen: canary health: requests 1.2k, errors 0.4% (mostly rate-limit), no regressions in promptset A. CPU on node-7 spiked once to 93% then recovered.

sheriff_miguel: looks ok. hold if anything >1% errors or latency p95 > 350ms.

alice: pinning artifact now. command: `releasectl pin --artifact redwood-inference:v2026-03-21-1 --env prod --by alice`

deploybot: [deploybot] artifact pinned: redwood-inference:v2026-03-21-1 to prod (txn 0x9f3b)

ben: added a note to the rollback doc: if fallback fails, open immediate rollback and route traffic to dedicated read-only pool. link: https://confluence.redwood/rc-rollback-playbook

carmen: final smoke in staging post-pin passed. ready for promo window.

alice: starting staged promotion at 1734567980. steps: 1) promote 5% prod traffic 2) wait 10m 3) promote 50% 4) wait 10m 5) full. abort criteria: errors >1% OR p95 > 400ms OR eval regression.

deploybot: [deploybot] promo step 1 -> prod traffic 5% started (job 3344)

carmen: step1 metrics: errors 0.35%, p95 210ms. OK

sheriff_miguel: continuing watch. no thumbs down yet.

deploybot: [deploybot] promo step 2 -> prod traffic 50% started (job 3345) at 1734568000

dave: small metrics blip during step2 but back to baseline. logging spike related to cache warm-up.

alice: promoting to 100% now.

deploybot: [deploybot] promo step 3 -> prod traffic 100% completed at 1734568012

ben: confirmed prod logs look healthy. no elevated errors. nice work. :tada:

alice: marking RC promoted. please update release notes with any last-minute callouts (dave, ben). I'll close the ticket after notes are stitched.

sheriff_miguel: sheriff handing off in 15m. no rollbacks necessary.

carmen: adding a postmortem checklist item to verify KV hit-rate steady over next 24h.

alice: thanks all. saving QA evidence and linking to ticket RED-3241.
